psychological_meaning: Riptide evokes feelings of tranquility and freshness, reminiscent of ocean breezes and serene coastal environments. It suggests clarity, renewal, and a calming presence. This color promotes a sense of balance and mental clarity, making it ideal for spaces intended for relaxation and reflection.
